items.title: OpenAI shares first measured results from its Jalapeño inference chip
items.summary: OpenAI published initial performance results from its custom Jalapeño inference chip and described a broader full-stack compute strategy.

items.title: Search Console platform properties are globally available
items.summary: Google says platform properties can track Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube performance across Search, Discover and Google News.

items.title: GitHub CodeQL 2.26.3 improves Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
items.summary: GitHub's August changelog includes CodeQL improvements for JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue and GitHub Actions analysis.

items.title: Chrome 152 enters early stable on desktop
items.summary: Google moved Chrome 152.0.7977.54/.55 into early stable for a small percentage of Windows and Mac users.

items.title: Chrome 151 security update includes five fixes
items.summary: Google's Chrome 151 desktop update lists five security fixes, including high-severity use-after-free issues.

items.title: GitHub adds a mitigated dismissal reason for code scanning alerts
items.summary: GitHub now lets code-scanning users mark an alert as mitigated when external controls reduce risk while the vulnerable code remains.

tool_of_day.summary: Build title, description and Open Graph tags with a live preview.
